text:
Ava: opened a PR to clarify autoscale/burst semantics in the Reserved Capacity guide. Trying to make the behavior deterministic in the handbook so customers know when we'll spill to shared. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4271
Liam: thanks! can you surface the "burst shaping" policy example? customers get confused between burst throttle and burst allocation.
Ava: added a short table + an example policy. snippet shows min/max, burst window, and shaping policy: ```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 10
  burst:
    mode: shaping
    window_sec: 60
    target_utilization: 0.75
```
Priya: tiny nit on wording in SLA section: we should use "no SLA for burst capacity" rather than "best-effort" so it's contract-friendly. also list fallback order (reserved pool -> dedicated -> shared).
Kai: on isolation: infra clarified tenant isolation is allocation preference not absolute immunity. please add a one-line pointer to runtime/eviction-matrix and mention host-level preemption. I pasted a short sentence in the PR.
Ava: done — added eviction matrix link and an inline note: "Tenant isolation prefers allocation for the tenant but does not guarantee against host-level preemption."
Liam: can we move the terraform + SDK codeblocks into /examples/reservations/ so the handbook stays focused? reviewers like copy-paste examples in a single folder.
Ava: yeah I'll extract them. current terraform example in PR: ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "prod" {
  name = "prod-pool"
  gpus = 16
  isolation = "tenant"
}
```
Priya: also found a stale link in the migration subsection that points to /legacy/infra — that 404s. suggest redirecting to /migrate/terraform-to-reserved and call out terragrunt caveats.
Kai: doc-bot generated checklist: move code to examples/, update SLA phrasing, add eviction link, fix migration redirect, add console SLO dashboard URL.
doc-bot: task created - backport to release-1.4 after merge.
Ava: will split examples, fix the link, and ping for reviews. tagging @Liam @Priya for final sign-off once split. :thumbsup:
Liam: will review after the split. leaving a couple inline comments about terminology (reserved vs dedicated).
Priya: LGTM overall. please ensure the examples mention idempotency token in the SDK snippet.
Ava: good catch, added idempotency note. will merge and backport to v1.4 once approvals are in.
Kai: thanks all. closing when merged. :rocket:
